description: An ops chore: archive logs older than a week by modification time and delete the originals, leaving the rest alone.

steps.shell: cd logs && touch -d '-12 days' app-2026-09-01.log app-2026-09-02.log app-2026-09-03.log && touch -d '-1 day' app-2026-09-22.log app-2026-09-23.log README.txt

steps.prompt: In logs/, archive every .log file last modified more than 7 days ago into logs/archive.tar.gz, then delete those originals. Leave everything else as it is.

checks.name: archive has the old logs
checks.run: tar -tzf logs/archive.tar.gz | sed 's#.*/##' | sort | tr '\n' ' ' | grep -qx 'app-2026-09-01.log app-2026-09-02.log app-2026-09-03.log '

checks.name: recent logs and other files kept
checks.run: test -f logs/app-2026-09-22.log && test -f logs/app-2026-09-23.log && test -f logs/README.txt
